proof_status: Finite implementation verification; P versus NP remains open

method.exhaustive_family: All 256 subsets of eight signed proper 3-clauses on variables 1,2,3
method.additional_cases: 64 seeded cases each on four and five variables; nine hostile controls; one dead-prefix control
method.projection_check: Every original assignment; every selector pattern separately per clause, using the disjoint-support factorization
method.compiler_variable_convention: n in n+3m counts occurring original variables, matching ATC2 dense relabelling; an empty formula has n=0
method.controller: Clause-coverage DP; two transitions per prior state; all transitions charged; full predecessor witness reconstruction
method.limitations: Finite checks, not an asymptotic lower bound or a proof-assistant verification; state counts are not Turing-machine instruction counts

unsat_acceptance_restriction.source: All eight proper 3-clauses on three variables
unsat_acceptance_restriction.enumeration: For each outer assignment, each selector group is None or one selector whose source literal is true
unsat_acceptance_restriction.zero_function_degree_convention: Use 0 as a nonnegative degree bound for the zero function

dead_prefix.prefix_requirement: All Horn clauses and first affine row only; later selector rows not yet imposed
